column1: # ISY503 Assessment 3 - group presentation video edit list.
# One row per take, in playback order. Tab-separated.
# mode      passthru = clip already shows the slides (Teams screen-share) -> normalise only
#           pip      = clip is bare webcam -> composite over the rendered slide, Teams-style
#           missing  = not recorded yet; build.sh skips it and warns
# in/out    seconds in the SOURCE file; "-" for "to the end".
# Luis recorded all of his parts in one 14-minute Teams session, so his rows are
# slices of the same file. Cut points were taken from a whisper transcript plus a
# silence map, and land on the LAST good take of each slide - he restarted slides
# 4, 7 and 10 on camera. Slide 12 is two rows because he fluffed a line in the
# middle of an otherwise good take, so the bad stretch (789.6-815.4) is dropped.
